notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked as a stub); its Walkthrough, Gameplay and Table of Contents subpages are linked but none exists, so nothing was used. alphaprotocol.fandom.com answers the API, with about 21 linked pages, including "Saudi Arabia", "Rome", "Moscow", "Taipei", "Safehouse", "Operation Desert Spear", "Al-Samad", "Michael Thorton" and "Halbech Corporation"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The game may have been taken off sale; this was not checked beyond the app still being in the Steam app list. Steam app 34010 returns an empty achievement schema, so steam=None. The first chapter follows the order of links on the Fandom game page (Saudi Arabia and Al-Samad first); Rome, Moscow and Taipei follow in the order they are linked there, which may not be the play order. The endgame chapter is a placeholder with no names from the data. RAWG lists a playtime of only 2 hours, which looks low.
